What this app does
Please read and confirm each item before continuing.
Network monitoring
A local VPN is created on this device. All network traffic passes through it so the app can show you which apps are communicating and with whom. No data leaves your device.
HTTPS traffic inspection (optional)

To read encrypted traffic contents, the app acts as a local HTTPS proxy. This requires installing a security certificate. The certificate lives only on this device and is deleted when you uninstall the app. You can use the app without this feature.
Local storage
Traffic logs are stored in the app\'s private storage on this device only. They are never uploaded anywhere. You can delete them at any time from Settings.
